props.name: activeIndex
props.description:
Active tab state
- Sets the initial active tab (e.g. 0 sets the first tab, 1 sets the second tab, etc.)

props.name: variant
props.description:
Tabs variant
- **default** Tabs are left-aligned, and the width of each tab is defined by the length of its content
- **stretch** Tabs stretch horizontally to have equal widths, which is calculated by the width of the screen divided by the number of tabs

events.name: onTabsChange
events.description: Fired when the active tab changes, whether by user interaction or programmatically. Detail: `{ value, activeTabIdx }`.

slots.description: The tab items for the tabs

slots.name: panel
slots.description: The tab panels that correspond to the slotted tab items
